description: Source code for NinePatchEditor class, a custom file editor for 9-patch images in Android development environment, handling image loading, saving, and UI interactions.

classes.name: NinePatchEditor
classes.description: A custom file editor for 9-patch images in Android, supporting image loading, editing, and saving, with integration into IDE features.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image from a VirtualFile and converts it to a compatible BufferedImage.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the current BufferedImage to the associated VirtualFile if modified.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the main UI component for the editor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the editor.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the editor.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Indicates if the file has unsaved changes.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the file is still valid.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Saves the file and disposes of UI resources.

methods.name: patchesUpdated
methods.description: Marks the editor as modified when patches are updated.
